evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of intermittent palpitations.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 85 bpm. Normal axis.
PR interval 173 ms, QRS 107 ms, QTc 442 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no accute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
65%. Mild mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: NormaI left ventricular systolic fuction.
